components.html:
GitHub fixture: repository

Read-only. Reports which account the token belongs to, reads one repository and lists an owner's repositories. The safest fixture to run first: it writes nothing, so it is the quickest way to find out whether a plugin configuration works at all.

  1. Ingelogde gebruiker ophalen
  2. Repository ophalen
  3. Repositories opsommen

components.label: Repository
components.description: Must be a repository the token of the plugin configuration may reach. Fill it in even when the configuration has a default — the fixtures build search queries and REST paths out of it.

components.label: Eigenaar
components.description: An organisation or a user, for the repository listing.
